entities.name: Allyl bromide
observations: The fragment [C][=C][C][Br] is interpreted as CH2=CHCH2Br, allyl bromide.
Acts as an SN2 alkylating reagent in the proposed transformation.

entities.name: 1,5-Pentanediol
observations: One hydroxyl group is proposed to undergo mono-allylation under sodium hydride.

entities.name: Sodium hydride
observations: [H-1].[Na+1] represents sodium hydride, a strong base used to generate an alkoxide from the diol.

entities.name: Mono-O-allylation of 1,5-pentanediol
observations: Proposed reaction: deprotonation of one terminal hydroxyl of 1,5-pentanediol followed by SN2 substitution with allyl bromide.
The symmetric diol gives one constitutional mono-allyl ether product.

entities.name: 5-(Allyloxy)pentan-1-ol
observations: A second equivalent of allyl bromide could produce the diallyl ether, but monoallylation is the likely product when one alkylating equivalent is represented.
